page.title: Creating a new listing
page.description: Expand your digital real estate portfolio. Learn how to upload unlimited properties to the Smart MLS ecosystem completely free of charge. This guide provides step-by-step instructions on structuring your listings to maximise their quality score, ensuring your inventory is instantly discoverable by active deal makers across the grid.
page.body:
Creating a New Listing: Expanding Your Shared Inventory


PropertyList operates as a powerful, collaborative infrastructure. As a verified agent, you have the strategic advantage of uploading unlimited properties to the Smart MLS and sharing them with the entire network, forever, completely free of charge.

Creating a new listing is a streamlined process engineered for speed, allowing you to deploy new mandates in just a few minutes, even directly from your smartphone.

The Smart Search Algorithm & Listing Score

Visibility on the grid is driven by data quality. The more comprehensive your property information, the higher your listing will be prioritised. Our system assigns a dynamic quality score based on the depth of the information provided and the visual standard of your media.

Step-by-Step Upload Guide

Simply follow these steps to deploy a new property to the network:

1. Basic Details

  • Sign in to your PropertyList account and navigate to your dashboard.
  • Click the “LIST PROPERTY” tab on the left-hand menu.
  • Location & Type: Enter the exact location and property type.
  • Orientation: Select the orientation. This refers to the direction its main living areas face in relation to the cardinal directions - north, south, east, and west.
  • Staff Assignment: Assign a dedicated staff member to manage the property. (Note: These users must be invited by the admin first).
  • Exclusive Mandates: Check the box if you hold an exclusive listing agreement. You may be asked to provide this agreement for verification purposes. Exclusive listings will be the only version of that specific property permitted on the grid, and you will receive an email notification if another agency attempts to upload a duplicate.
  • Description & Languages: Add your property description in your preferred languages. We highly recommend including English and Spanish as a minimum. Strategic Tip: The Smart Search algorithm scans for specific keywords within your description, so be comprehensive. The more detail you provide, the higher your property score, making it easier for co-broking agents to find!

2. Features & Media

  • Click the “FEATURES” tab. Select all applicable amenities to ensure maximum exposure in filtered searches.
  • Click the “MEDIA” tab. Upload your high-resolution property photos. Remember, superior image quality directly increases your listing's visibility score.
  • Video: You can also embed a direct link to your property's video tour.

3. Pricing & Commissions Click the “PRICING” tab and select whether the property is for SALE or RENT.

  • SALE: Add the Sale Price, IBI, Basura (trash collection), and community fees. Crucially, insert the commission percentage you are offering to the co-broking agent (all prices are +IVA).
  • RENT (Long-term): Add the monthly rental price and the security deposit amount. Insert the co-broking commission, which is standardly shared 50/50. (Important Legal Compliance: Due to the current Housing Law in Spain, it is obligatory for all agency commissions on long-term rentals to be borne by the owner or entity of the property).
  • RENT (Holiday): Add the weekly rental price. Insert the co-broking commission, which is standardly shared 50/50. 
  • Furnishing: Check the box if the property is furnished, or leave it blank for unfurnished.

4. Contacts (Optional but Recommended) Click the “CONTACTS” tab.

Here, you can seamlessly link the legal owner's details to the mandate.
You can search your existing Smart CRM for a saved contact or create a new profile to link directly to this specific property.

5. Admin Workspace (Private Internal Data) Click the “ADMIN” tab.

Please note: Information entered in the Admin section is entirely private and visible only to your agency's authorised administrators.

  • Address: Add the exact, private property address.
  • Keys: Check the box if your agency has the physical keys in your possession.
  • Private Notes: Add internal memos or viewing instructions that only your team can access.
  • Documents: Attach vital paperwork such as the Nota Simple or Floor plans directly to the listing.
  • Tags: Apply custom tags to your properties for internal tracking and easier pipeline management.

Maximise Exposure: Feature Your Listing

Once your property is live, you can strategically deploy your credits to feature the listing. Upgrading your listing pushes it to the top of the MLS search results, targeting the right audience of active agents and boosting your immediate inquiries.


IMPORTANT LEGAL COMPLIANCE!

Before listing any property on the PropertyList network, you must ensure you hold two critical documents:

Proof of Ownership: A recent Nota Simple or Escritura to verify legal ownership.

Signed Authorisation: A formal Listing Agreement signed by all legal owners. If the property is owned by a corporate entity, the agreement must be signed by the company’s officially authorised administrators.
